part.text:
Implemented a TypeScript static site generator CLI with the requested features and tests.

What’s included
- CLI (yargs) with commands:
  - build: --src, --templates, --out, --baseUrl, --include-drafts, --clean, --watch, --serve, --port
  - dev: shorthand for watch + serve (includes drafts by default)
- Frontmatter parsing using gray-matter (title, date, tags, draft, layout, slug)
- Markdown rendering via marked with highlight.js syntax highlighting
- Handlebars template engine
  - Partials loaded from templates/partials/**/*.hbs
  - Layouts loaded from templates/layouts/**/*.hbs
  - Default layout fallback if none provided
- Tag index pages at /tags/<tag>/ using a tag layout if present, else a minimal fallback listing
- RSS feed generation at /rss.xml (uses baseUrl if provided)
- Dev server
  - Static file server for output dir
  - WebSocket live reload on changes (chokidar watches src and templates)
  - Injects a WS reload script into generated HTML during dev
- Copies non-Markdown assets from source to output, preserving structure
- Output paths
  - index.md -> /index.html
  - foo.md -> /foo/index.html
  - nested paths respected

Project structure
- src/cli.ts: CLI entry and argument handling
- src/builder.ts: Build pipeline (parse, render, write, tags, rss, assets)
- src/server.ts: Dev server, watcher, and live reload
- src/templates.ts: Handlebars loading, partials/layouts registration, rendering helpers
- src/markdown.ts: marked and highlight.js setup
- src/types.ts: shared types
- test/frontmatter.test.ts: frontmatter parsing
- test/templates.test.ts: layout + partial application and markdown rendering
- test/cli.test.ts: CLI flags behavior (drafts)

Run it
- Install: npm i
- Build: npm run build
- Dev: npm run dev -- --src <src> --templates <tpl> --out <out> [--baseUrl https://example.com] [--port 5173]
- Build once: npx tsx src/cli.ts build --src <src> --templates <tpl> --out <out> [--baseUrl ...]
- Tests: npm test

Conventions
- Templates:
  - Layouts under templates/layouts/*.hbs (default.hbs recommended)
  - Partials under templates/partials/*.hbs (refer with {{> partialName}})
  - Context in layouts: page (frontmatter + url), site (pages, tags, baseUrl, buildTime), body (rendered HTML)
- Tags:
  - Gathered from frontmatter tags field (array or comma-separated string)
  - Sorted by date descending within each tag
  - Provide optional templates/layouts/tag.hbs for custom tag pages
- RSS:
  - rss.xml generated with latest posts (up to 50)
  - Absolute links if baseUrl provided, else relative paths
- Live reload:
  - Injected only when devServerPort is provided (dev or build --serve/--watch)
  - WebSocket endpoint: ws://<host>:<port>/livereload

Notes
- Tests verified:
  - Frontmatter parsing robustness across timezones
  - Template rendering with partials and body injection
  - CLI flag behavior for including drafts
- package.json includes build/test scripts and a binary pointing to dist/cli.js (after tsc build). Use tsx during development.

If you want, I can add an example template and sample content directories to demonstrate usage, or extend the builder to support a global index page template.
